verses.pali: Saṁyutta Nikāya 15.8
verses.english: Linked Discourses 15.8

verses.pali: 1. Paṭhamavagga
verses.english: Chapter One

verses.pali: Gaṅgāsutta
verses.english: The Ganges

verses.pali: Rājagahe viharati veḷuvane.
verses.english: Near Rājagaha, in the Bamboo Grove.

verses.pali: Atha kho aññataro brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṁ sammodi.
verses.english: Then a certain brahmin went up to the Buddha, and exchanged greetings with him.

verses.pali: Sammodanīyaṁ kathaṁ sāraṇīyaṁ vītisāretvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi. Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho so brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: When the greetings and polite conversation were over, he sat down to one side and asked the Buddha,

verses.pali: “kīvabahukā nu kho, bho gotama, kappā abbhatītā atikkantā”ti?
verses.english: “Worthy Gotama, how many eons have passed?”

verses.pali: “Bahukā kho, brāhmaṇa, kappā abbhatītā atikkantā.
verses.english: “Brahmin, many eons have passed.

verses.pali: Te na sukarā saṅkhātuṁ:
verses.english: It’s not easy to calculate

verses.pali: ‘ettakā kappā iti vā, ettakāni kappasatāni iti vā, ettakāni kappasahassāni iti vā, ettakāni kappasatasahassāni iti vā’”ti.
verses.english: how many eons have passed, how many hundreds or thousands or hundreds of thousands of eons.”

verses.pali: “Sakkā pana, bho gotama, upamaṁ kātun”ti?
verses.english: “But worthy Gotama, can you give a simile?”

verses.pali: “Sakkā, brāhmaṇā”ti bhagavā avoca.
verses.english: “I can,” said the Buddha.

verses.pali: “Seyyathāpi, brāhmaṇa, yato cāyaṁ gaṅgā nadī pabhavati yattha ca mahāsamuddaṁ appeti, yā etasmiṁ antare vālikā sā na sukarā saṅkhātuṁ:
verses.english: “Consider the Ganges river from where it originates to where it meets the ocean. Between these places it’s not easy to calculate

verses.pali: ‘ettakā vālikā iti vā, ettakāni vālikasatāni iti vā, ettakāni vālikasahassāni iti vā, ettakāni vālikasatasahassāni iti vā’ti.
verses.english: how many grains of sand there are, how many hundreds or thousands or hundreds of thousands of grains of sand.

verses.pali: Tato bahutarā kho, brāhmaṇa, kappā abbhatītā atikkantā.
verses.english: The eons that have passed are more than this.

verses.pali: Te na sukarā saṅkhātuṁ:
verses.english: It’s not easy to calculate

verses.pali: ‘ettakā kappā iti vā, ettakāni kappasatāni iti vā, ettakāni kappasahassāni iti vā, ettakāni kappasatasahassāni iti vā’ti.
verses.english: how many eons have passed, how many hundreds or thousands or hundreds of thousands of eons.

verses.pali: Taṁ kissa hetu?
verses.english: Why is that?

verses.pali: Anamataggoyaṁ, brāhmaṇa, saṁsāro.
verses.english: This transmigration has no known beginning.

verses.pali: Pubbā koṭi na paññāyati avijjānīvaraṇānaṁ sattānaṁ taṇhāsaṁyojanānaṁ sandhāvataṁ saṁsarataṁ.
verses.english: No first point is found of sentient beings roaming and transmigrating, shrouded by ignorance and fettered by craving.

verses.pali: Evaṁ dīgharattaṁ kho, brāhmaṇa, dukkhaṁ paccanubhūtaṁ tibbaṁ paccanubhūtaṁ byasanaṁ paccanubhūtaṁ, kaṭasī vaḍḍhitā.
verses.english: For such a long time you have undergone suffering, agony, and disaster, swelling the cemeteries.

verses.pali: Yāvañcidaṁ, brāhmaṇa, alameva sabbasaṅkhāresu nibbindituṁ, alaṁ virajjituṁ, alaṁ vimuccitun”ti.
verses.english: This is quite enough for you to become disillusioned, dispassionate, and freed regarding all conditions.”

verses.pali: Evaṁ vutte, so brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: When he said this, the brahmin said to the Buddha,

verses.pali: “abhikkantaṁ, bho gotama, abhikkantaṁ, bho gotama …pe…
verses.english: “Excellent, worthy Gotama! Excellent! …

verses.pali: upāsakaṁ maṁ bhavaṁ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṁ saraṇaṁ gatan”ti.
verses.english: From this day forth, may the worthy Gotama remember me as a lay follower who has gone for refuge for life.”

verses.pali: Aṭṭhamaṁ.
